title: Chapter 7: WSGI Adapter
description: Implements WSGI compatibility over the native batch architecture. Consolidates wsgi-adapter, wsgi-core-adapter, and wsgi-extension-support. Django and Flask applications run on Vertebra with high performance through a lazy environ mapping, a dedicated synchronous runner, and optional per-framework hooks.
performance_gate: Basic WSGI echo app must sustain >= 150,000 req/s in wrk benchmark on same hardware as native batch gate.
gates: Flask hello-world mountable and returns correct response
Django hello-world mountable and returns correct response
